query: European Commission DMA non-compliance decision against Google Search Article 6(5) self-preferencing July 2026 - has a formal decision been adopted or announced? Latest status as of mid-July 2026
answer:
The research is complete. **Summary: A formal decision has been adopted.**

On **July 23, 2026** (with underlying adoption reported July 22), the European Commission formally issued a DMA non-compliance decision against Google Search for self-preferencing under **Article 6(5)**, fining Google **€460 million**. This was part of a combined **€890 million** package alongside a separate €430 million Google Play steering decision — the Commission's first-ever and largest DMA fine to date.

Note on the "mid-July 2026" framing: as of ~July 15–16, the fine was reported by FT and Handelsblatt as *imminent* but **not yet formally adopted**; the formal decision came on July 22–23, 2026.
